purpose: Distinguish printed wraps, paragraph boundaries and authored sections. Compare adding independently embedded neighbors, re-embedding the combined passage, and combining both on identical candidates and output text.
weights: Uncapped .55 adjacent-unit cores and immediate sentence neighbors. Sweep total neighbor weight from 0 to 100% in steps of 1%. Cross core/neighbor proportions and joint-vector proportions in steps of 5%. As a separate control interpolate the final query scores between the 30% additive key and the joint key, at 5% intervals. Repeat the one-dimensional sweep at .25, .40 and with 256-token blocks at 5% resolution. Use unit input directions and cosine. Preserve the exact displayed windows across rankings.
choice: Choose each family's best first-hit and best top-five complete-evidence setting on development, breaking ties on the other metric, then first-hit evidence F1 and simpler weights. Evaluate frozen choices on reused confirmation and source-disjoint replication from the prior study, using the audited replication citations. These sources have already been inspected. Also report paired document uncertainty, leave-one-domain-out sensitivity and agreement between ranking keys.
scopes: Compare unlimited merging at .25 and .40 with no boundary, explicit sections, major headings, and paragraphs/turns. Independently compare delivering adjacent chunks without a scope limit and clipping to each of these three boundary types. A sectionless document is one section. Preserve complete parser units. Use the same equal-weight whole-chunk and best-contained-unit score. Ordinary 256-token blocks are a fixed-core delivery control.
audit: Scan all 209 normalized sources for paragraph joins consistent with physical wrapping. Compare candidate government breaks with original source HTML or span annotations and visually check original PDF pages for suspicious filings. Test native parser soft wraps, real paragraph breaks, lists and headings directly. Keep narrower or broader source scopes distinct from inference about unavailable layout.
followups: After examining the initial sweep, test reciprocal-rank fusion at constants 10 and 60, alternating the two lists and choosing their larger cosine. Test soft section boundaries that permit crossing when edge-unit cosine reaches .40 or .60. These additional comparisons are exploratory.
